# Coal is King

> Authentic charcoal grill restaurant in Stockholm, Sweden. All meat is grilled
> over real oak and hickory charcoal at 800°C. Founded 2019.

## Key facts
- Address: Kungsgatan 14, 111 35 Stockholm, Sweden
- Phone: +46 8 123 456 78
- Email: hej@coalisking.se
- Hours: Mon–Fri 12–22, Sat–Sun 12–23
- Cuisine: Charcoal grill, steakhouse, BBQ
- Signature dishes: Ribeye 300g (dry-aged 28 days), T-bone 500g, Pork Belly Burnt Ends, Coal-smoked Ribs, Coal-burnt Crème Brûlée
- Reservations recommended, up to 12 guests in main dining room
- Vegetarian options available (grilled halloumi, charcoal vegetables)

- [Home](https://coalisking.se): Menu, story, gallery, booking form
